title: Weak-field waveforms for generic relativistic orbits
abstract: Worldline path-integral (Schwinger-Keldysh) computation of gravitational-wave waveforms for generic relativistic orbits in flat space.
key_claims: Demonstrates current worldline-PI technology, but in FLAT space (not hyperbolic/AdS).
Logged for worldline-sweep completeness; not actionable for HYP-027.
